id: title:VojtechBartos:keep unowned p0 reports out of the briefing

review.posthog_relevance: Adds an optional `include_unowned` parameter to report retrieval and response handling, allowing users to opt-in to including P0 unowned reports in their personal inbox and API responses while retaining the default exclusion. This changes backend behavior and API compatibility.
review.reason: The observed changes introduce a new optional parameter `include_unowned` to report retrieval and response handling. P1.F7.H1 adds the parameter extraction from request data, while P1.F10.H1 updates the backend and MCP service to support this flag, changing the default behavior of excluding P0 unowned reports. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The exact impact on user experience and adoption is not demonstrated; this is a feature implementation, not a proven benefit. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a new optional parameter `include_unowned?: boolean` to the SignalsReportsForYouRetrieveParams type and its corresponding API response, while updating documentation to clarify that P0 unowned reports are excluded unless this flag is false.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the backend `InboxCounts` and briefing generation to pass `include_unowned=False` when fetching reports, excluding P0 unowned reports from the user's personal inbox and briefing, while retaining them in the project-wide open report count.

observations.behavior: Adds the same `include_unowned?: boolean` parameter to the MCP service's generated API types and documentation, aligning the external service with the backend and frontend changes.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the MCP service's API response and request parameters to support the new unowned report exclusion flag, ensuring consistency across the ecosystem.
